ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 85:15 ratio of high-intensity (white/light grey) to low-intensity (black) pixels on the visible fluke surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large contiguous high-intensity region across both lobes. Continuous low-intensity (black) band along the trailing edge. A primary low-intensity focal spot located immediately left of the median notch. Two secondary low-intensity circular spots in the right lobe's medial-distal region. Heavy low-intensity mottling at the extreme lateral tips.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped notch with an interior angle of approximately 65 degrees; depth is clearly defined despite water spray at the base.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, low-amplitude serrations along the continuous trailing edge boundary. Serrations become more pronounced and irregular (higher amplitude) toward the distal tips.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Broad convex sweep from the notch to the tips, characterized by an upward-curving parabolic arc on the trailing boundary.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Detection of two distinct dark circular pixel clusters on the right lobe and several faint, circular high-intensity (white) pockmarks/scars on the left lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Multiple parallel, unaligned linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) oriented diagonally across the lower-medial regions of both lobes, appearing as low-contrast dark lines against the white surface.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A prominent dark focal lesion or pigmentation anomaly adjacent to the median notch. Extensive parallel rake mark scarring across the mid-ventral surface.
other_distinctive_markers: The specific triangular configuration of the dark spot near the notch relative to the two medial spots on the right lobe creates a unique identifier.
